data.value: Turns off Timeline: Windows no longer records or uploads the list of your recent activities.

data.name: Optim_priv_location_Desc
data.value: Denies location access at the system level. Can be re-enabled anytime in Windows settings.

data.name: Optim_priv_tailored_Desc
data.value: Stops Windows from using your diagnostic data to show personalized suggestions and targeted ads.

data.name: Optim_priv_app_launch_tracking_Desc
data.value: Windows stops tracking the apps you launch to personalize the Start menu and search.

data.name: Optim_priv_feedback_Desc
data.value: Removes the Windows notifications that ask for your feedback (Feedback Hub).

data.name: Optim_gaming_highperf_Desc
data.value: Activates the Windows High Performance power plan to maximize CPU/GPU resources.

data.name: Optim_gaming_gamedvr_Desc
data.value: Removes the Xbox background video recording that consumes CPU, RAM and disk I/O.

data.name: Optim_gaming_fullscreen_Desc
data.value: Prevents Windows from intercepting game fullscreen mode, reducing micro-stutters.

data.name: Optim_gaming_priority_Desc
data.value: Configures Windows to prioritize CPU resources for foreground applications.

data.name: Optim_gaming_directx_Desc
data.value: Optimizes DirectX settings: disables DXGI flip model debug and tunes the GPU scheduler.

data.name: Optim_gaming_kill_processes_Desc
data.value: Stops non-essential processes to free RAM and CPU before launching a game.

data.name: Optim_gaming_fps_unlock_Desc
data.value: Disables the artificial frame rate limit and Windows-forced V-Sync.

data.name: Optim_gaming_gpu_schedule_Desc
data.value: Enables Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS) to reduce graphics latency.

data.name: Optim_oldpc_startup_Desc
data.value: Disables unnecessary programs at Windows startup.

data.name: Optim_oldpc_animations_Desc
data.value: Removes heavy visual effects to smooth out the UI.

data.name: Optim_oldpc_registry_Desc
data.value: Removes MRU entries and orphan keys from the Windows registry.

data.name: Optim_oldpc_ram_Desc
data.value: Empties the Working Sets of all processes via the Win32 EmptyWorkingSet API (real and effective method).

data.name: Optim_oldpc_temp_Desc
data.value: Deletes %TEMP%, C:\Windows\Temp folders and unnecessary files.

data.name: Optim_oldpc_defrag_Desc
data.value: Runs defragmentation on disk C: (HDD only — ignored on SSD).

data.name: Optim_oldpc_theme_Desc
data.value: Disables transparency and Aero effects to save GPU.

data.name: Optim_clean_disk_Desc
data.value: Launches Disk Cleanup (cleanmgr) to remove unnecessary files and caches.

data.name: Optim_clean_recycle_Desc
data.value: Permanently deletes all files in the Windows Recycle Bin.

data.name: Optim_clean_logs_Desc
data.value: Exports then clears Windows event logs (advanced troubleshooting mode).

data.name: Optim_clean_prefetch_Desc
data.value: Removes Prefetch files (advanced troubleshooting action; may temporarily slow down first launches).

data.name: Optim_clean_bloatware_Desc
data.value: Uninstalls common Windows bloatware (Candy Crush, Solitaire…).

data.name: Optim_clean_repair_Desc
data.value: Runs sfc /scannow then DISM to repair corrupted system files.

data.name: Optim_clean_antivirus_Desc
data.value: Runs a Windows Defender QuickScan showing the number of files scanned. Offers to quarantine detected threats. Timeout extended to 10 minutes.

data.name: Optim_net_tcpip_Desc
data.value: Tunes the Windows network stack: autotuning, ECN, timestamps for better performance.

data.name: Optim_net_reset_Desc
data.value: Resets all network settings (netsh winsock reset + int ip reset). Reboot required.

data.name: Optim_net_dns_fast_Desc
data.value: Benchmarks several DNS profiles then automatically applies the fastest one on physical network adapters (skipped on domain-joined PCs). The previous configuration is backed up.

data.name: Optim_net_dns_restore_Desc
data.value: Reverts to the DNS configuration saved before the fast DNS optimization was applied.

data.name: Optim_net_ping_Desc
data.value: Reduces network latency by tuning TCP timers and disabling ACK delays.

data.name: Optim_net_telemetry_block_Desc
data.value: Blocks connections to Microsoft tracking and telemetry servers via the hosts file.

data.name: Optim_net_flush_dns_Desc
data.value: Clears the local DNS cache (ipconfig /flushdns) to fix browsing issues.

data.name: Optim_net_reset_firewall_Desc
data.value: Restores the default Windows Firewall configuration (all custom rules will be removed).

data.name: Optim_net_speed_test_Desc
data.value: Measures download speed (multi-run) + ping, jitter and packet loss.

data.name: Optim_net_info_Desc
data.value: Displays local IP, DNS, gateway, MAC address and status of active network interfaces.

data.name: Optim_stream_perf_mode_Desc
data.value: Activates the High Performance power plan and disables CPU C-States to stabilize encoding and avoid drops on transitions.

data.name: Optim_stream_cpu_prio_Desc
data.value: Detects OBS, Streamlabs, Davinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere, Vegas Pro running and switches them to Above Normal priority for encoding.

data.name: Optim_stream_game_mode_off_Desc
data.value: Disables Windows Game Mode which can throttle hardware encoders (NVENC / QuickSync / AMF) during streaming. Effect varies by GPU.

data.name: Optim_stream_hags_off_Desc
data.value: Disables Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling which causes NVENC artifacts on some Windows 10/11 configs. Reboot required.

data.name: Optim_stream_killer_Desc
data.value: Closes parasitic processes during encoding: Adobe Updater, Edge background, Spotify, Discord (overlay), GitHub Desktop, Microsoft Teams.

data.name: Optim_stream_clean_cache_Desc
data.value: Clears the Streamlabs / OBS browser source caches that accumulate and slow down startup.
